name: Pumpkin Seed + Flax Granola
ingredientsText: Whole grain rolled oats*, cane sugar, soy oil*, brown rice flour pumpkin seeds, flax seeds* oat syrup solids* [oat syrup solids*, tocopherols (added to enhance freshness)], sea salt, molasses*, cinnamon*. *Organic.
mayContainStatement: Produced in a facility that uses wheat, peanuts and tree nuts
notes: Soy oil alone would be possible, but the printed 'Contains soy.' makes soy contains. Brown rice flour is not wheat.
